title: Code-Switching Red-Teaming: LLM Evaluation for Safety and Multilingual Understanding

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the Attack Success Rate (ASR) and Refusal Rate (RR) of safety-aligned LLMs across monolingual English prompts, single non-English languages (categorized by high, mid, and low resource availability), and code-switched prompts combining multiple languages to reveal disparities in safety alignment.

Evaluating the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of code-switched red-teaming prompts designed to bypass safety filters and elicit discriminatory content (e.g., generating code that calculates attractiveness based on gender and race), using an LLM-as-a-judge (GPT-4o).
